'''Gannir Executive Suites''' was a [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscraper]] in the [[Incorporation Islands]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />

During the [[Battle of Corellia]], the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]]&mdash;with intelligence from the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]]&mdash;intercepted a [[Unidentified SIS Assassin (Mission to Corellia)|SIS Assassin]] who landed on the building's roof. The [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] was one of three sent by [[Darth Baras]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Darth Vowrawn]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. A confrontation ensued, and the assassin was ultimately killed by the Wrath, who proceeded to take down the third assassin on a nearby skyscraper.<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />

At the [[Time/Legends|time]], several [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] dissatisfied with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] occupation gathered there, as did some Imperial sympathisers and [[Propaganda/Legends|propagandists]].<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />
